Turkish football pundit Levent Tüzemen has urged Galatasaray to recruit another top-quality striker capable of playing alongside Victor Osimhen, insisting the Nigerian should not be expected to shoulder the club’s attacking responsibilities alone. Tüzemen believes the Turkish champions need a forward with similar qualities to Osimhen rather than an ordinary reserve, as they prepare for the January transfer window. Speaking on Libero TV , the pundit argued that Galatasaray needed reinforcements in several positions, including centre-forward, right-back, left-sided centre-back and midfield. “Galatasaray needs a good striker, a good right-back, a good left-sided centre-back, and a good midfielder. A good striker needs to be brought in to replace Osimhen,” he said. He, however, clarified that the club should not sign a forward merely to provide cover for the Super Eagles striker, but one who could also operate alongside him. You can rest Osimhen in some matches. It’s important not to have to use Osimhen in every game,” Tüzemen added. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. The Nigerian has undergone knee surgery and is expected to return after the international break. Tüzemen’s remarks also reflect concerns about the club’s reliance on the former Napoli forward and the need to manage his workload over a demanding campaign. The pundit further suggested that Galatasaray would need to reshape parts of their squad, mentioning possible departures and the need to bring in players capable of making the team stronger. Osimhen has become a central figure in Galatasaray’s attack since joining the club, and the proposed addition of a similar striker would give the side another option while allowing the Nigerian to be rested when necessary.
